description: Holding attack with the pistol fires at once, then every fire_interval (0.35 s, 21 ticks at 60 Hz) for as long as attack is held.

expect.note: The starting weapon is ready at spawn, so the first shot is on the first tick.
Tick 21: the cooldown from the first shot hasn't run out; the second shot is on tick 22.
Shots on ticks 1, 22, 43, ... 169; the tenth would be on tick 190, after 3 s.
